close_reason: Already fixed/folded into fz-kdt.34.5 in PR #106 (db83fb0c2). The emitter still supplies a HashSet, but the public JSONL boundary renders every complete fact identity and sorts the strings before writing the array; telemetry docs specify that order and both focused stall-event tests pass at a3a9761d1. The separate mint-order FactKey concern remains in fz-kdt.114. File fresh rather than reopen if public bytes become RandomState-dependent again.
description:
Bycatch from the fz-kdt.109 refutation (2026-09-01): drive.rs:~636
renders stall_demanded (a HashSet<FactKey>) into the
fz.compiler2.drive.demand_on_stall telemetry event unordered -- the same
defect class fz-kdt.109 fixed on stderr, on the telemetry stream
instead. Harmless until stream bytes become a comparand (which this
epic's canonical-comparand discipline keeps trending toward). Fix =
the same packaging sort at the render site; if fz-kdt.114 lands first,
use its StableSortKey<Types> for FactKey.
title: demand_on_stall telemetry renders a HashSet in iteration order
